fields.summary: Search returns soft-deleted notes (tombstones not checked)
fields.description:
R3 finding: search hits notes that were deleted 30+ minutes ago. `Store.list()` walks the filesystem before checking the deletion tombstone. Order needs to flip, and the tombstone check needs an index or search will get slow at scale.

## Repro

```sh
loop delete note-a
sleep 60
loop search a  # <— note-a still in results
```

comments.body: Filing as sev-2; user-facing data-visibility bug.
Fix draft: swap order in Store.list, add tombstone bloom filter for O(1) check. PR #84 (wip).
Ready for review. Bloom filter false-positive rate 0.1% (acceptable, filter re-checks the tombstone on hit).
